**NEAR Intents** is a multichain transaction protocol on NEAR Protocol where users simply state the outcome they want (e.g., "swap 1 ETH on Ethereum for USDC on Arbitrum"), and a network of competing third-party executors (solvers) figure out how to fulfill it—abstracting away bridging, gas management, and route selection. `[1]` `[2]`

---

**Sources**

[1] NEAR Intents — https://intents.near.org/
[2] What are Intents? — https://docs.near-intents.org/getting-started/what-are-intents
